proof_body:
by
  intro α _ μ f g p hp hf hg
  have hp0 : 0 < p := by linarith
  have h0 : ENNReal.ofReal p ≠ 0 := by simpa using hp0
  have ht : ENNReal.ofReal p ≠ ⊤ := ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top
  have hr : (ENNReal.ofReal p).toReal = p := ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp0.le
  have e : ∀ u : α → ℝ, MeasureTheory.MemLp u (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ → MeasureTheory.eLpNorm u (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ = ENNReal.ofReal ((∫ a, |u a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p)) := by
    intro u hu
    have := hu.eLpNorm_eq_integral_rpow_norm h0 ht
    simpa [hr, one_div] using this
  have h1 := MeasureTheory.eLpNorm_add_le hf.1 hg.1 (p := ENNReal.ofReal p) (by simpa using hp)
  have hfg : MeasureTheory.MemLp (f + g) (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ := hf.add hg
  rw [e _ hfg, e _ hf, e _ hg] at h1
  have n1 : 0 ≤ (∫ a, |f a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) := by positivity
  have n2 : 0 ≤ (∫ a, |g a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) := by positivity
  rw [← ENNReal.ofReal_add n1 n2] at h1
  exact (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff (add_nonneg n1 n2)).mp h1
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (f g : α → ℝ) (p : ℝ), 1 ≤ p → MeasureTheory.MemLp f (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ → MeasureTheory.MemLp g (ENNReal.ofReal p) μ → (∫ a, |f a + g a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) ≤ (∫ a, |f a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) + (∫ a, |g a| ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p)
